package.description: Fast local disk space visualization for Windows with cushion treemaps.

en-US.description: Fast local disk space visualization for Windows with cushion treemaps.
en-US.longDescription: AtlayaView scans one or more drives and turns used storage into an instantly readable treemap, making large folders and files visible at a glance. It is a local-first Windows desktop application with an optional native Rust renderer and automatic fallback to the managed renderer.
en-US.name: AtlayaView
